# HandleSprite <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Sprites](Blitz3D-Sprites)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HandleSprite:Void sprite:Int32, x_handle:Float32, y_handle:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sprite` | In | Int32 | required | The sprite. |
| `x_handle` | In | Float32 | required | Horizontal handle position. The default is 0. |
| `y_handle` | In | Float32 | required | Vertical handle position. The default is 0. |

## Description

Moves the point that the sprite is held at, which is also the point it turns and scales around. 0, 0 is the middle. The handle is measured in half the size of the sprite, so -1, -1 is one corner and 1, 1 the opposite one.
